title: A little rest
summary: Fattoush and Knafeh want to catch up, but both need a pause.

scenes.title: A quick hello
scenes.situation: Fattoush hopes to catch up with Knafeh. First, she checks how he is doing.

text.meaning: How are you doing? (casual check-in to Knafeh)

scenes.title: Both need a pause
scenes.situation: The conversation reveals a small problem: neither has much energy for a long catch-up.

scenes.title: A little rest
scenes.situation: Fattoush offers a pause. Knafeh says what he needs; their catch-up can wait.

text.meaning: Do you want to rest? (to Knafeh)
Yes, I want to rest a little.
